privacy: Redistributable abstract design seeds only; creator preferences, source attachments, paths, dates and review outcomes are excluded.
mother_rules: one dominant hero or information claim per frame
extreme scale contrast creates hierarchy before decoration
one dominant colour field plus one or two controlled accents
subjects participate in depth through overlap, shadow, crop or foreground occlusion
microtype, grain, scanlines and marks finish the frame but never compete with the hero
motion preserves the still-frame hierarchy and must reveal, compare, explain or pay off
long-form and short-form share design DNA but must reflow rather than crop
a grid is an optional information surface and never a default opener
hero typography acts as a compositional mass, not a small bottom caption
one dense information cluster is paired with one deliberate quiet lane
outlined display, pixel mono and editorial grotesk are separate regimes and never all active together
composition skeleton and surface art direction are learned through separate channels
choose one spatial skeleton and at most one image-placement modifier before styling
layout-only references never contribute palette, material or motion tokens

learning_contract.isolation_rule: Layout-only boards teach position, proportion and hierarchy across families. Their placeholder colour, texture and motion are never compiled as taste.
learning_contract.selection_rule: Choose one composition primitive and at most one image-placement modifier; then apply one approved art family. Never stack a whole reference board.

references.composition: editorial collage with asymmetric columns and one oversized typographic or portrait interruption
references.type: large display Chinese/Japanese mixed with narrow editorial metadata
avoid: using every typographic style at once

references.composition: interlocking organic geometry with generous warm-paper margins
references.hierarchy: large colour masses > outline shapes > hand marks > micro label
references.type: plain black grotesk used as a quiet anchor
avoid: six colours with no dominant field

references.composition: soft abstract body silhouette built from luminous geometric volumes
references.hierarchy: sculptural silhouette > quiet headline > date metadata
references.type: thin light sans with calm spacing

references.composition: black stage with two large surreal rings, oversized numerals and vertical type
references.hierarchy: hero numerals and rings > vertical event title > fine programme copy
references.type: mixed display serif, outline sans and pixel accents under one hierarchy

references.composition: modular white field invaded by dense blue and aqua circular systems
references.hierarchy: cropped wordmark mass > circular swarm > black ribbon accents > metadata
references.type: heavy geometric sans with severe crops

references.composition: white editorial page with one faceted photo mosaic and local illustrations around it
references.hierarchy: destination name > photo mosaic > human illustration > local annotations
references.type: friendly rounded destination word plus restrained Japanese text
avoid: turning every shot into a postcard

references.composition: single food bowl floating on a saturated yellow stage with giant perspective title
references.hierarchy: food hero > giant title > vertical description > price
references.type: huge heavy Japanese display plus thin vertical copy

references.composition: full-width banner dominated by giant brush characters behind a central white title cluster
references.hierarchy: central title > background brush rhythm > event metadata
references.type: expressive brush paired with small italic serif

references.composition: full-frame abstract 3D corridor above a clean white information band
references.hierarchy: immersive 3D space > oversized event title > date metadata
references.type: wide sports display on a clean band

references.composition: black stage filled with perspective-curved ticket ribbons and one small breathing void
references.hierarchy: main pink ribbon > date ticket > call to action > micro metadata
references.type: condensed ticket sans following warped surfaces
avoid: too many readable surfaces at once

references.composition: one oversized illustrated game hero occupies the calm centre while navigation rails, progress and action modules stay on the perimeter
references.hierarchy: character silhouette > weapon and face > current objective > peripheral navigation and currency
references.type: compact heavy Chinese UI labels with white sticker edges, notification pills and short high-contrast action copy
avoid: dense sticker wall on non-game footage
interface chrome replacing the real subject or proof

references.composition: warm paper field contains one large pixel operating-system window framing an illustrated landscape, with only a few cursor and dialog satellites
references.hierarchy: pixel title and landscape > active warning dialog > note window > loading indicator
references.type: large pixel display word paired with bitmap monospaced window labels and short utility prompts
motion: landscape holds as the emotional reward
avoid: fake operating-system state presented as proof
tiny mono copy below phone legibility

references.composition: a layout-planning board comparing centred, diagonal, scatter, triangular, nine-grid, enveloping, curve, segmented and corner-anchored spatial skeletons
references.hierarchy: one dominant mass establishes the eye path; headline and metadata anchor opposing edges while secondary explanation occupies a quiet pocket
references.type: placement study only: headline may centre, split, rotate, step vertically or counterbalance a large image mass; typeface appearance is not learned
motion: translate the chosen skeleton through one reveal path only
avoid: learning the grey placeholders as a palette
treating the board itself as one style

references.composition: an image-placement planning board comparing tiled, split, crossover, deliberately misaligned, centred, uniform-size, bleed, colour-block and type-image arrangements
references.hierarchy: image geometry is selected by the information task first; headline, caption and metadata occupy remaining negative space rather than floating over important image content
references.type: placement study only: text can oppose, cross, frame or label image geometry while preserving a single reading start; typeface appearance is not learned
motion: reveal one image relationship such as split, crossover or bleed; never animate every tile
avoid: covering faces or proof with crossover type
using misalignment without a deliberate baseline

references.composition: a tall ultramarine construction field carries a vertical chain of monochrome human fragments, bird silhouettes, orbit lines and modular rectangles, all organised around one rising gesture
references.hierarchy: large central photographic gesture > top reaching fragment > cobalt structural slabs > white star and black disc > typewriter notes
references.type: small typewriter mono appears in contained note blocks while the photographic collage remains the hero; utility copy never becomes a subtitle strip
motion: central cutout rises through the frame
one cobalt bar locks a note
bird silhouettes separate as a restrained release
avoid: random collage without a directional spine
more than one saturated hue family
copying source prose or silhouette arrangement

references.composition: a hard grey-to-black vertical field is structured by enormous cropped sans words, outlined letterforms, arrow diagrams and two geometric discs carrying one continuous spectral material
references.hierarchy: oversized black word blocks and numeral > one spectral typographic or circular carrier > outlined directional letters > vertical metadata > compact explanatory copy
references.type: ultra-bold grotesk and hairline outline grotesk share one grid; cropped words act as architecture, with narrow vertical metadata and compact readable body copy
motion: spectral band travels through one carrier
outline arrows establish a single reading route
cropped word blocks reveal by mask
avoid: rainbow on every word and shape
using spectral fill as a generic gradient
thin outline copy below phone scale
claiming 3D when the treatment is flat typography
